clips.title: The story
paras: Talondeep Path cuts beneath the ridge between Ashenvale and the Stonetalon Mountains. The quiet tunnel links the woods west of Mystral Lake to Windshear Crag.

Talondeep Path runs beneath the ridge between Ashenvale and the Stonetalon Mountains. The tunnel links the woods west of Mystral Lake to the northwestern reaches of Windshear Crag. Surface trails cross dangerous country, with predators and warring factions, but the passage is calm and has no hostile beasts or encampments. Twisting side pockets, crevices, and natural alcoves break up the rock. Above ground, faint traces of an old road remain along the peaks, where travelers once crossed before the sheltered route through the stone.
